summary: The user met an individual with the handle rhea_travels_22 on a dating app and engaged in a video call on a Monday. Later that week, the user received an explicit extortion demand requiring 15000 by tomorrow 8 pm to a specified UPI ID under threat of sending the recorded video to the user's followers.

categories.rationale: The contact explicitly stated they would send the recorded video to all of the user's followers if payment is not made.
An exact financial demand of 15000 via a specific UPI identifier was received.
The extortionist specifically threatened to distribute the recording to all followers of the user.
The interaction began on a video call without indication that recording was disclosed or consented to.

timeline.event: User met rhea_travels_22 on a dating app and moved to a video call.
User received explicit message demanding 15000 by tomorrow 8 pm.
Stated extortion deadline for sending payment to the provided UPI ID.

factors: Explicit financial extortion with impending deadline
Threat to broadcast non-consensual video to user followers
Perpetrator has possession of victim follower list or contacts

actions.title: Do not pay money and do not send more media
actions.why: Paying extortionists does not ensure deletion and often leads to higher repeated demands.

actions.title: Preserve complete chat logs and profile evidence
actions.why: Capturing full profile URLs, payment messages, and timestamps is necessary before blocking or reporting.

actions.title: Contact cybercrime helpline if financial transaction occurred
actions.why: Immediate reporting to 1930 helps freeze fraudulent financial transactions if payment was initiated.

actions.title: Secure social accounts and lock follower lists
actions.why: Changing passwords and making account followers private reduces the perpetrator's leverage.

actions.title: Submit formal report to National Cyber Crime Reporting Portal
actions.why: Formal government documentation creates a legal record and aids portal investigations.

evidence_items.item: Full screenshot of the extortion message showing deadline and payment demand
evidence_items.how_to_preserve: Capture uncropped screen displaying date, time, and sender identifier clearly.

evidence_items.item: Dating app profile screen and profile URL or handle of rhea_travels_22
evidence_items.how_to_preserve: Capture user profile details, bio, and account identifier before account deletion.

evidence_items.how_to_preserve: Save exact text and screenshot of the requested payment address.

evidence_items.how_to_preserve: Capture screenshot of call log with duration, timestamp, and caller ID.
